title: Two Cousins and a Song
paragraphs: Mary set off at once to visit Elizabeth, a long walk into the hill country. When Mary called out a greeting, the baby inside Elizabeth leapt for joy, and Elizabeth cried out that Mary was blessed among women, and so was the child she carried. Two women, one old and one young, both with astonishing news, held each other. Then Mary sang. "My soul doth magnify the Lord, and my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour" (KJV). Her song is about a God who lifts up the humble, feeds the hungry, and turns the world the right way up. It's been sung in churches ever since, as the Magnificat.
wonder: I wonder who you would run to if you had big news?
activity: Ring or visit a friend or relative and share something good.
prayer: God who lifts the lowly, fill us with joy and make us glad to share good news. Amen.
alt: Two women embrace at a doorway on a hilltop path, surrounded by a loop of golden thread and music notes.
hidden: A tiny bird singing on the roof.
translation: Retold in our own words, with a short quotation from the King James Version.
